rng = np.random.default_rng(4)

def power(n, pa=0.24, pb=0.30, sims=2000):
    a=rng.binomial(n,pa,sims)
    b=rng.binomial(n,pb,sims)
    pool=(a+b)/(2*n)
    z=(a-b)/n/np.sqrt(2*pool*(1-pool)/n)
    sig=2*stats.norm.sf(abs(z))<.05
    return sig.mean()

power_200 = power(200)
power_800 = power(800)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def perm_test(a, b, n_perm=2000, seed=0):
    a,b=np.asarray(a),np.asarray(b)
    x=np.r_[a,b]
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    obs=a.mean()-b.mean()
    hits=0
    for _ in range(n_perm):
        v=rng.permutation(x)
        hits+=abs(v[:len(a)].mean()-v[len(a):].mean())>=abs(obs)
    return obs,hits/n_perm

from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportions_ztest

def compare_shares(late_a, late_b):
    a,b=np.mean(late_a),np.mean(late_b)
    n,m=len(late_a),len(late_b)
    d=100*(a-b)
    w=196*np.sqrt(a*(1-a)/n+b*(1-b)/m)
    p=proportions_ztest([sum(late_a),sum(late_b)],[n,m])[1]
    return f"A: {100*a:.1f} %, B: {100*b:.1f} %, разница {d:.1f} п.п. (95 % ДИ {d-w:.1f}…{d+w:.1f}), p = {p:.4f}"

import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportions_ztest

def ab_report(df, metric):
    a,b=df.loc[df.group=="A",metric],df.loc[df.group=="B",metric]
    n,m=len(a),len(b)
    srm=stats.chisquare([n,m]).pvalue
    p=proportions_ztest([a.sum(),b.sum()],[n,m])[1]
    return dict(n_a=n,n_b=m,srm_p=srm,a=round(a.mean(),4),b=round(b.mean(),4),diff_pp=round(100*(b.mean()-a.mean()),2),p=round(p,4),significant=p<.05 and srm>=.01)

ab = pd.read_csv("ab_push.csv")
report = ab_report(ab, "ordered")
report

from scipy import stats

days, per_day, sims = 7, 200, 1000

pv=[]
n=np.arange(1,days+1)*per_day
for _ in range(sims):
    a=(rng.random((days,per_day))<.1).sum(axis=1).cumsum()
    b=(rng.random((days,per_day))<.1).sum(axis=1).cumsum()

    pv.append(2*stats.norm.sf(abs(z)))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportions_ztest

def promise_report(ab):
    srm_ok=stats.chisquare(ab.groupby("group").size()).pvalue>=.01
    def contrast(v,col):
        g=v.groupby("group")[col]
        a,b=g.mean()
        return 100*(b-a),proportions_ztest(g.sum(),g.size())[1]
    late,lp=contrast(ab[ab.ordered==1],"late")
    conv,cp=contrast(ab[ab.distance_km<2],"ordered")
    a,b=ab.amount[ab.group=="A"],ab.amount[ab.group=="B"]
    r=b.mean()-a.mean()
    p=stats.ttest_ind(b,a,equal_var=False).pvalue
    w=1.96*np.sqrt(a.var()/len(a)+b.var()/len(b))
    lo,hi=r-w,r+w
    if not srm_ok or late>=0 or lp>=.05 or hi < -10:
        result="не внедрять"
    elif lo > -10:
        result="внедрять"
    else:
        result="продлить тест"
    return dict(srm_ok=srm_ok,late_diff_pp=round(late,1),late_p=lp,conv_short_diff_pp=round(conv,2),conv_short_p=cp,rev_diff=round(r,1),rev_p=p,rev_lo=round(lo,1),rev_hi=round(hi,1),decision=result)

ab = pd.read_csv("ab_promise.csv", parse_dates=["ts"])
promise_report(ab)
